definition: [ שָׁאַן ] verb Pa`lel ( Ges «GKC:55d»§ 55d ) be at ease or at peace, rest securely (Syriac pacify , Ethiopic peace ); — Perfect 3 masculine singular שַׁאֲנַן Jer 48:11 , ׳ וְשׁ consecutive Jer 30:10 +; 3 plural שַׁאֲנָ֑נוּ Job 3:18 — be at ease, secure , undisturbed by ill fortune: ׳ וְשָׁקַט וְשׁ וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד Jer 30:10 = Jer 46:27 ; Jer 48:1 l (of Moab); מִפַּחַד רָעָה ׳ שׁ Prov 1:33 of rest from trouble, etc., in grave Job 3:18 . שְׁאָן see בֵּית שְׁאָן . P. 112
